subject: Approval request: Single-vendor migration for sales sequences — budget & PO next steps
messages:
From: Matthew Coleman <matthew.coleman@outreach.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Quotation: Site-wide migration to Outreach Sequence Pro — quote & T&Cs

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the time last week. Attached is our updated quote and migration plan for moving Acme's global SDR/AE sequences onto Outreach Sequence Pro. Key points: 
- One-time migration service (data export + sequence mapping) included in year-1.
- 3-year term recommended for committed unit pricing; 15% list discount applied at 3-year term.
- Professional services SOW attached for phased onboarding.

Attachment: Outreach_Q3_quote_ACME.pdf (pdf, 1 page — summary pricing)

If you want, I can share a sample SOW and proposed timeline. Happy to join a quick sync with procurement/legal next week.

Best,
Matthew Coleman
Strategic Accounts — Outreach
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Matthew Coleman <matthew.coleman@outreach.io>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quotation: Site-wide migration to Outreach Sequence Pro — quote & T&Cs

Laura / Marissa / Ben — looping you in.

On the vendor side we have a clean commercial: Outreach is proposing a consolidated move for all sequence tooling (they are aware we currently run a couple of legacy providers for subset teams). The quote is attached by Matthew (see original below). Important asks from my side:

- Business case: projected token/unit cost reduction from unified sequences + admin maintenance savings.
- Term: vendor prefers 3-year for the 15% discount; want to confirm finance willingness to commit.
- Migration: included in year-1 but we should lock SLAs for data fidelity and cutover windows (we lose some staging time over Q1).

Requested next steps:
1) Laura: executive sign-off on multi-year commitment or alternative (scope to cap year-1 spend).
2) Ben / Finance: validate if we can commit to the 3-year spend; if not, recommend delta (12–24 months) and acceptable discount.
3) Marissa: coordinate with CS to confirm migration plan and staffing for the migration waves.

I can coordinate a procurement call with Matthew and Acme procurement next week if we have alignment.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quotation: Site-wide migration to Outreach Sequence Pro — quote & T&Cs

Jonas — thanks for the summary.

High-level: I support consolidating onto a single vendor if the projected OPEX savings and admin reduction are real. A few guardrails before I sign off on multi-year: 
- Legal: I need the redline SOW and T&Cs (term, data protections, termination CL). Please route to legal and procurement for review — do not execute until redlines are cleared.
- Budget cap: limit year-1 cash outlay to not exceed $420k; beyond that finance needs to amortize across FY27/28.
- Escalation: include an SLA for critical sequence failures (response < 1 hour during business hours).

If Finance confirms the 3-year model fits within the committed forecast, I’ll approve the exec ask. Please get a HubSpot deal updated (Jonas — can you attach the quote to the deal?) and book a 30-min procurement sync.

Laura Bennett
VP, GTM Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Matthew Coleman <matthew.coleman@outreach.io>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quotation: Site-wide migration to Outreach Sequence Pro — quote & T&Cs

Laura / team — finance checked projected impact and we can accommodate the 3-year commitment provided we: 
- Stage payments: 40% upfront, 30% at migration completion, 30% at 12 months.
- Put the excess into a committed spend line so P&L treatment is predictable.

I've prepared a preliminary PO and attached it for routing. If legal confirms T&Cs and procurement confirms vendor forms, we can issue PO-ACME-5678 once Outreach confirms the SOW redlines.

Attachment: PO_ACME_5678.pdf (pdf stub — PO for Outreach, includes payment schedule)

Matthew — can you confirm Outreach accepts staged payment and the 15% 3-year discount in writing? If yes, I will request procurement to issue the PO and notify accounts-payable.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Finance Manager — Redwood Inference
